messages:
Keisha (People Ops): FYI Rowan starts 10/14 remote. Need: I-9 path, BG check clearance, laptop + monitor ship, payroll forms, and benefits intro. Can we divvy?
Arun (HR): I'll handle I-9 intake and payroll forms. For remote I-9 we do video verification + Section 1 beforehand. Rowan, which ID will you use?
it-queue: Laptop request queued. Please confirm shipping address and whether to include external monitor. ETA 3 business days after provisioning.
Rowan (newhire): Passport + SSN card available. Ship to 303 Pine St, Unit 201, Portland, OR 97205. Monitor please if stock allows.
Sofie (Hiring Manager): Add Rowan to eng-frontend, qa-channel, and schedule a 30-min team intro on Wed morning. No on-call first month.
Arun (HR): Thanks. Rowan, I'll send the secure I-9 portal link. Complete Section 1 and upload ID pics before the verifier call. Verifier slots Tue & Wed mornings.
Rowan (newhire): Got the portal link. I'll complete Section 1 tonight. Quick question: background check vendor asks for previous 7-year address history — is that required?
Arun (HR): Yes most vendors need 7-year history. If you can't remember exact dates, approximate is OK but add notes. If anything flags we'll reach out.
Keisha (People Ops): Benefits intro is scheduled Fri 10/18 11am PT (20 mins). @benefits-bot sending invite. Enrollment window = 30 days from start.
benefits-bot: Calendar invite sent to rowan@example.com with benefits packet link. Reminder 1 day before.
it-queue: Provisioning notes:
```
# internal bootstrap
create-asset --model MacBookPro16 --owner rowan@redwood.com
attach-monitor --model 27in-UHD
enroll-mdm --profile developer
ship --address "303 Pine St, Unit 201, Portland, OR 97205" --carrier FedEx
```
Rowan (newhire): Thanks! One more payroll Q: do you support split direct deposit? I want part to a savings account.
payroll-bot: Payroll supports up to 2 accounts. Please submit direct deposit form with split percentages within 3 business days of hire.
Arun (HR): Background check vendor (NationScan) marked "in progress". Typical 24-72h. I'll post here when cleared.
Keisha (People Ops): Action items recap: Arun = I-9 + payroll + bg follow-up; IT = device + monitor + Okta + repo groups; Sofie = team invites & intro meeting; Rowan = complete Section 1 + upload IDs + direct deposit.
NationScan (automated): Background check completed 
Status: CLEAR. No criminal records found in returned jurisdictions.
Rowan (newhire): Completed Section 1, uploaded passport & SSN card, and submitted direct deposit with split 70/30. Thanks everyone! :tada:
